notes.title: MORTEM Update 1.2!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I've been working on a new slight bug-fix / improvement update for the past weeks!

It's most part gameplay improvements and slight additions to effects and more content! I will say that I am working on a update that will bring more gameplay modes and even something much more! :)

Thank you for playing and stay tuned for this update!

-Daníel Ómar
Nighthood Games

notes.title: Mortem VR Update!
notes.content:
Mortem VR version 1.1 features Nightmare mode, bugfixed and a boost in performance!

The game is also going to be releasing on Oculus Store soon!
The game is on sale now, be sure to check it out!

-Daniel
